question: Typhoid is caused by __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bacteria**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Typhoid is caused by the bacterium **Salmonella typhi**.
 
• This infection is primarily spread through **contaminated food and water**.
 
• Common symptoms of typhoid include **high fever, weakness, stomach pains, headache, and loss of appetite**.
 
• Diagnosis of typhoid is typically confirmed through **blood tests** that detect the presence of Salmonella typhi.
 
• Effective treatment generally includes the use of **antibiotics** to kill the bacteria causing the infection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Bacterial Infections**

 
 
• **Cholera**: Caused by the bacterium Vibrio cholerae, leading to severe diarrhea and dehydration.
 
• **Tuberculosis**: Caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs.
 
 
 
• **Protozoan Infections**
 
 
• **Malaria**: Caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted through Anopheles mosquito bites.
 
• **Amoebiasis**: Caused by Entamoeba histolytica, leading to gastrointestinal issues.
 
 
 
• **Viral Infections**
 
 
• **Influenza**: Caused by influenza viruses, leading to respiratory illness.
 
• **HIV/AIDS**: Caused by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus, affecting the immune system.
